findings.summary: B7 is non-discriminating for DD_RUN_ID, so mutation N4 ('让 DD_RUN_ID 显式覆盖失效') cannot be killed. Both B7 cases set DD_RUN_ROOT, which takes precedence in bin/deep-research-loop.sh:25, so the DD_RUN_ID branch of RUN_ID="${DD_RUN_ID:-...}" (line 24) never determines RUN_ROOT. If DD_RUN_ID override were broken so that RUN_ID always fell back to the nanosecond default, both assertions would still pass. The second test is titled 'DD_RUN_ID controls RUN_ROOT layout <root>/.runtime/deep-research/<id>' but asserts only run_root===DD_RUN_ROOT, never that layout. No other test in the repo exercises DD_RUN_ID alone (a9-tick-trigger.test.ts uses only DD_RUN_ROOT). Spec §2 B7 requires DD_RUN_ID override semantics be asserted verbatim, and §3 requires N4 be killed by B7; dev-notes line 107 claims 'N4 亲跑 B7 挂', which the test code cannot support for a DD_RUN_ID-only mutation. This is spec §3.1 discipline item 2: the assertion does not hit the semantic location, and green is misread as 'implementation is correct'.

B1 — one of the two criteria the spec declares irreplaceable — silently PASSES when the loop-engine CLI or bun is absent. The guard `if (!existsSync(cli) || !bun) { return; }` is a bare return, not it.skip and not a loud failure, so the acceptance command reports green while asserting nothing about reason==='drained' or the seed reaching status 'done'. This is exactly the silent-zero-result / '工具自己静默失效并报告成功' anti-pattern banned by spec §3.2 and §0.2. Because B1 is the only assertion that proves natural convergence, a vacuous pass means mutation N1 (max_nodes back to 1) would also go undetected in any environment lacking bun. Spec §5 permits pointing LOOP_ENGINE_CLI at the prepared worktree build; it does not authorize skipping.

B2 is verified with a stubbed bus, which the criterion explicitly forbids ('真跑后读 channel 断言；⛔ 不得用打桩 bus 替代'). The test replaces global fetch via vi.stubGlobal and counts publishes against a fabricated channel 'research:verified-evidence-chan', so no real research.evidence.v2 message is ever observed on a real evidence channel. The dev-note (lines 88-98) documents the environmental constraint honestly — all reachable evidence channels are frozen or research:v1-* reserved, and research:p02-smoke-1dce60 has no .evidence sibling — and the implementer correctly refused to derive a channel name by string concatenation or write a forbidden channel. That honesty is the right call, but B2 as specified remains unsatisfied and should be resolved by provisioning a verified-existing writable evidence channel or by an approved spec amendment, not by a substitution the criterion bans.

Product changes for §1.1 and §1.2 are correct and well-reasoned. max_nodes 1→2 makes convergence follow deterministically from board state (hasPendingWork) rather than round counting, timing, or a reduced max_passes, and max_passes remains 16 in workflows/deep-research/fleet.yaml.tpl:1. The nanosecond+PID RUN_ID default eliminates the same-second RUN_ROOT collision. Non-goals hold: no loop-engine repo change, no protocol registration, no .dd-evidence/ directory, no IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md at repo root, --max-writes default 5 and the v1 frozen-channel refusal are intact, and the evidence channel still has no derived default. The findings above concern acceptance rigor, not the correctness of the fix itself.
